name: Kansas
agency: KanCare Clearinghouse (Kansas Department of Health and Environment)

period.description: Medically Needy uses a six-month base period; once your bills reach the spenddown, you have coverage for the rest of it.

submission.description: List your bills on the spenddown claims form (ES-3170), one form per provider, and mail or fax it to the KanCare Clearinghouse. Providers can also send bills for you.

notes: Premiums you pay for health insurance and Medicare can count, and so can rides to medical care.
Older bills count only for the amount you still owed on the first day of the base period.
Bills you use for the spenddown are still yours to pay.
Keep your fax confirmation page in case the Clearinghouse needs it.

sources.title: 7330 Eligibility Periods - Kansas Economic and Employment Services Manual (KEESM)
